description: An all-pass phaser of up to eight one pole stages, with a triangle LFO sweeping their frequency and a wet mix

params.text: Sets the frequency of the all-pass stages, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets how many stages the signal passes through, 0 to 8, blending between whole numbers rather than stepping
Moves every stage between bypass at fully counter-clockwise, a high pass at the centre and an all-pass fully clockwise
Mixes between the dry input at fully counter-clockwise and the filtered signal fully clockwise
Sets the LFO rate, four octaves either side of 1Hz
Sets how far the LFO sweeps the stage frequency, up to two octaves either side at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Moves the stage frequency one octave per volt on top of the FRQ knob
Adds to the number of stages, one stage per volt
Moves the bypass to all-pass setting on top of the BHA knob, a tenth of its range per volt
Adds to the wet mix, ten per cent per volt
Moves the LFO rate one octave per volt on top of the LFO knob
The signal filtered, despite the maker's tooltip on this jack reading LFO gain level

outputs.text: The LFO triangle, -10V to 10V, running whatever the LVL knob is set to
The filtered signal mixed with the dry input by the WET knob

notes: the LFO runs at all times and its output is usable on its own; the LVL knob only sets how much of it reaches the filter
